correctness.rationale: The all-graph proof is mathematically sound. Under girth≥5, any two distinct open neighborhoods share at most one vertex, preventing simplex facet overlap beyond vertices; min degree≥2 makes all neighborhoods distinct maximal simplices. For each center v choose c_v∈N(v) and collapse all lower faces σ⊂N(v)\{c_v}, |σ|≥2, paired with σ∪{c_v} in decreasing cardinality. At each step σ has precisely one remaining strict coface; no other neighborhood simplex contains two of its vertices. Resulting graph has Σ_v(deg v−1)=2m−n distinct edges and n vertices. Edge paths are exactly even-length graph walks, giving one component for nonbipartite G and the two color classes for bipartite G. Euler cycle ranks are 2m−2n+1 or each m−n+1. Independently executed exact free-face collapse checks on C5 and C6. No unsupported infinity extrapolation from those tests; proof is all-graph.
